jane_auditor: Hi team — auditor checkpoint: they need a concise evidence bundle for control mapping around the recent vuln triage (CVSS 7.2) affecting inference routing. Specifically: RBAC change history for service accounts, KMS key access logs for the timeframe, and tie-back to incident runbook steps. They want explicit boundaries (what's in-scope vs out-of-scope). Can we produce that by EOD?

mira: Yep. I'll own the RBAC and service-boundary doc. Quick Q: do we include the staging cluster? Auditor asked about 'production-only' but also wants any cross-boundary escalation.

jane_auditor: production only for control assertion, but include a short note if staging shares credentials or service principals. Just call out any shared keys or role bindings.

sam: For RBAC history: we have the k8s rolebinding PRs in infra-git under repo infra/iam. Useful artifacts:
- PR list: https://git.redwood/infra/iam/pulls?q=rolebinding
- k8s-audit snapshots in s3://redwood-prod-logs/k8s-audit/2026-03/
I can export a filtered audit log for the timeframe: query will be something like: 
```splunk
index=\"k8s_audit\" source=\"app=*inference*\" earliest=\"2026-03-12:00:00\" latest=\"2026-03-15:23:59\" | search objectRef.kind=RoleBinding OR verb=bind
```
That will give who bound which role to what subject.

mira: Nice. For the KMS side I'll gather CloudTrail and Key access records. Two quick commands for sanity checks you can run locally: 
```bash
# CloudTrail lookup for KMS decrypt/GenerateDataKey usage
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=Decrypt --start-time 2026-03-12T00:00:00Z --end-time 2026-03-15T23:59:59Z

# Check key rotation/wrapping metadata
aws kms describe-key --key-id arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123:key/abcd-ef01
```
I'll record the exact key ARNs for the bundle.

alex: I'll map the vuln triage timeline to the incident runbook entries and attach the runbook steps used (triage -> canary -> rollback) and the comms snapshots. For attestations, we should include a short timeline.csv that maps: timestamp, actor, artifact, evidence_link. I'll assemble that.

jane_auditor: Please ensure the evidence files are small and direct links (no broad s3 prefixes). Auditor wants deterministic snapshots, not live pointers.

mira: Understood — I'll create zipped snapshots and a manifest.md that lists SHA256 for each exported file. Also will mark any caveats re: sampling (e.g., we sampled k8s-audit lines where objectRef.name matches inference-* and duty-cycle was high).

sam: One more thing: RBAC drift question — auditor asked if any elevated rolebindings were ever granted to human accounts vs service accounts. Quick grep I ran: 
```bash
git log --pretty=format:'%h %an %ad %s' -- infra/iam | grep -i rolebinding | sed -n '1,200p'
```
I found two PRs where an oncall@redwood service account was added for emergency access (PR 4021, merged 2025-11-02). I will flag these in the notes.

evidence-collector-bot: evidence-collector: bundle job started for thread=7312345678, target_bucket=s3://redwood-audit-bundles/7312345678/ — status=collecting

mira: Plan of attack: 1) export k8s-audit slice + splunk query results, 2) export CloudTrail KMS events and key descriptions, 3) package RBAC PR diffs and PR metadata, 4) timeline.csv + manifest.md with checksums, 5) short executive summary (1 page) mapping controls to artifacts. I'll drop artifacts to s3://redwood-audit-bundles/7312345678/ and send presigned links.

jane_auditor: Thanks — please add a short note explaining any limitations (e.g., log retention gaps, sampling). Auditor prefers transparency. If anything can't be produced, call it out.

alex: Will add a mapping table: control_id -> artifact_link -> explanation. Also will include the incident runbook version and who executed steps (from oncall logs).

sam: ETA: I'll have RBAC export and PR list in ~2h. Mira ETA for KMS exports ~3h. Alex ETA for timeline ~4h.

jane_auditor: Great — I'll check back in 5 hours for the bundle links. :thumbsup:

evidence-collector-bot: evidence-collector: bundle job progress=40% for thread=7312345678

mira: Quick caveat: one KMS key (arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123:key/zzzz-1234) is customer-managed for Dedicated customers and logs are in a separate account; I'll include the cross-account request we sent and indicate missing live keys.

jane_auditor: Perfect. Call out that cross-account limitation in the manifest and include the request ticket number. Thanks all.
